name: playtest-loop
description: Play, file, fix, replay: a full playtest (bots and the AI player), QA reproduces every issue from its recorded inputs and turns it into a regression, the engineer fixes them, the regressions replay and a fresh playtest runs, until it passes or three fix rounds are spent.

goal.description: What a player must achieve (the game's won state says it is reached).

play.title: Playtest
play.prompt: Stage: loop-play. Playtest the game: game_playtest with the goal ({{input.goal}}) and the checks it implies (bots goal, explore, monkey), then play it yourself with game_play and add your session (sessions). Write docs/playtest-report.md with findings, each with its replay file and evidence frame.

triage.title: Reproduce and file
triage.prompt: Stage: loop-triage. Reproduce every issue in docs/playtest-report.md and the latest playtest report by replaying its recording (game_bot scripted); turn each confirmed bug into a regression (saveAs + expect, failing now). Write docs/qa.md (issue, severity, reproduced, regression file, status). Answer CLEAN when there is nothing BLOCKING or MAJOR, else ISSUES.

fix.title: Fix
fix.prompt: Stage: loop-fix. Fix every open BLOCKING and MAJOR issue in docs/qa.md (fix round {{state.rounds}}; three at most). game_playtest action regress must pass afterwards; then run game_playtest with the goal ({{input.goal}}) so the latest report is the fixed game.

replay.title: Replay and re-file

failed.title: Stopped: issues remain after the rounds allowed
